exposure: Placenta Accreta Spectrum Score (PAS) 0, PAS1, and PAS 2
International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) classification of placenta accreta spectrum disorder
cohort: 80 pregnant women; 40 with placenta accreta spectrum disorder (case group) and 40 with normal pregnancies (control group)
